As of now, the latest stable Python release is Python 3.15.1 (released Oct 21, 2026). If you’re looking for the very latest pre-release, Python 3.16.0a1 is available (as of Oct 13, 2026).

How to check on your machine:
- python3 --version
- or python --version (depending on your setup)

Where to get it:
- Python official downloads page: https://www.python.org/downloads/

If you want, I can re-check live for you or guide you through upgrading on Windows/macOS/Linux.
